import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    corr_threshold = 0.6
    keep_ids = set(feats.ids)
    correlations = {}
    
    # Build correlation matrix
    X = feats.x.copy()
    for i, id1 in enumerate(feats.ids):
        for j, id2 in enumerate(feats.ids[i+1:], i+1):
            if i != j:
                corr = np.corrcoef(X[:,i], X[:,j])[0,1]
                if abs(corr) >= corr_threshold:
                    correlations[(id1, id2)] = corr
    
    # Remove one feature from each highly correlated pair
    to_remove = set()
    for (id1, id2), corr in correlations.items():
        if id1 in keep_ids and id2 in keep_ids:
            # Remove the one with lower effect size
            mean1_1 = np.mean(X[feats.y==1, feats.column(id1)])
            mean0_1 = np.mean(X[feats.y==0, feats.column(id1)])
            mean1_2 = np.mean(X[feats.y==1, feats.column(id2)])
            mean0_2 = np.mean(X[feats.y==0, feats.column(id2)])
            
            effect1 = abs(mean1_1 - mean0_1)
            effect2 = abs(mean1_2 - mean0_2)
            
            if effect1 < effect2:
                to_remove.add(id1)
            else:
                to_remove.add(id2)
    
    # Filter out near-duplicates
    filtered_ids = [id for id in feats.ids if id not in to_remove]
    
    if len(filtered_ids) == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Select features with highest effect sizes
    effect_sizes = []
    for id in filtered_ids:
        col = feats.column(id)
        mean1 = np.mean(X[feats.y==1, col])
        mean0 = np.mean(X[feats.y==0, col])
        effect_sizes.append(abs(mean1 - mean0))
    
    # Select top features (max 4 to avoid exceeding limit)
    top_indices = np.argsort(effect_sizes)[::-1][:min(4, len(filtered_ids))]
    selected_ids = [filtered_ids[i] for i in top_indices]
    
    # Check if any mechanism exists
    if len(selected_ids) == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Use PCA to find a weighted score
    selected_cols = [feats.column(id) for id in selected_ids]
    X_selected = X[:, selected_cols]
    
    # Standardize
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_selected)
    
    # Apply PCA
    pca = PCA(n_components=1)
    scores = pca.fit_transform(X_scaled).flatten()
    
    # Create loadings dictionary
    loadings = dict(zip(selected_ids, pca.components_[0]))
    
    # Return design
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(selected_ids),
        columns=tuple(selected_ids),
        products=(),
        loadings=loadings
    )
